contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus fraction of House of Constantine (306-361), Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust possibly laureate right. Obverse inscription: CONSTA[---]. Reverse description: Altar inscribed VO/TIS/XX. Reverse inscription: BEATA [---]. In exergue: [--]P. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 1.09gms, die axis: probably 6
